title: Intent | Multiple Intents | Priority Handling | Sequential Processing | FD First |
description:
Customer mentions multiple needs in one message. System must detect all intents, prioritize them (FD compensation > expense claim > accessibility FAQ), and handle sequentially. Tests the intent prioritization logic discussed in the call transcript.

Prerequisites:
PNR: TCED12; Customer has disrupted flight AND hotel expense AND accessibility question; 1 leg AC (YYZ?YVR); Delay 5 hrs; Code 42; APPR
